interfaces.name: RecallClock
interfaces.signature: public protocol RecallClock { func now() -> Date }
interfaces.notes: Inject into domain scheduling/time-boundary functions and parsers to make day-boundary and timezone tests deterministic.

interfaces.name: DayBoundaryCalculator
interfaces.signature: public protocol DayBoundaryCalculator { func startOfTomorrow(relativeTo instant: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> Date }
interfaces.notes: Single point of truth for calendar-day computation used by due checks and reminder windows.

interfaces.name: SM2Quality
interfaces.signature: public enum SM2Quality: Int, Codable { case again = 2, hard = 3, good = 4, easy = 5 }
interfaces.notes: Explicitly locks grade mapping to quality values.

interfaces.name: SM2CardState
interfaces.signature: public struct SM2CardState: Codable { public let cardID: UUID; public let easeFactor: Double; public let intervalDays: Int; public let repetitionCount: Int; public let dueDate: Date }
interfaces.notes: Pure domain input/output for transition math, independent of SwiftData.

interfaces.name: SM2TransitionResult
interfaces.signature: public struct SM2TransitionResult { public let next: SM2CardState; public let grade: SM2Quality; public let elapsedDays: Int }
interfaces.notes: Returned after each grade; include enough state for persistence and audit trail.

interfaces.name: SM2Engine
interfaces.signature: public enum SM2Engine { public static func schedule(current: SchedulingState, grade: Grade) -> SchedulingState; public static func isDue(dueDate: Date, now: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> Bool; public static func startOfTomorrow(now: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> Date }
interfaces.notes: Namespace of pure static functions. Literal SuperMemo-2 arithmetic, EF floor 1.3, lapse (q<3) resets repetitionCount to 0 / intervalDays to 1. startOfTomorrow is the single shared calendar-day-boundary definition used by isDue, forecast bucketing, and history bucketing.

interfaces.name: CSVRowStatus
interfaces.signature: public enum CSVRowStatus: Equatable, Sendable { case ok(front: String, back: String, note: String?); case emptyFront; case emptyBack; case wrongColumnCount(Int); case malformedQuoting; case invalidEncoding; case duplicateInFile; case duplicateInDeck; case capBlocked }
interfaces.notes: One case per enumerated malformed/duplicate/cap-blocked reason from prior phases; capBlocked and duplicate* are distinct from malformed per DEC-per_app_product_brief-005 and DEC-detailed_discussion-006.

interfaces.name: ParsedCSVRow
interfaces.signature: public struct ParsedCSVRow { public let sourceLine: Int; public let front: String; public let back: String; public let note: String?; public let status: CSVRowStatus; public let normalizedKey: String }
interfaces.notes: Normalized key is case-sensitive exact front+back concatenation for deterministic duplicate detection.

interfaces.name: CSVParseOptions
interfaces.signature: public struct CSVParseOptions { public let expectedColumns: Int = 3; public let acceptNoteColumn: Bool = true; public let allowBom: Bool = true }
interfaces.notes: Parser can accept front/back and optional note while rejecting malformed structural cases explicitly.

interfaces.name: CSVParseResult
interfaces.signature: public struct CSVParseResult { public let rows: [ParsedCSVRow]; public let totalOk: Int; public let totalRejected: Int; public let canImportCount: Int }
interfaces.notes: Never drop silently; importer always drives preview from this complete result.

interfaces.name: CSVParser
interfaces.signature: public enum CSVParser { public static func parseImportPreview(data: Data, existingCards: [(front: String, back: String)], remainingCapacity: Int?) -> [CSVRowStatus]; public static func exportCSV(cards: [(front: String, back: String, note: String?)]) -> Data }
interfaces.notes: Pure, no I/O. Case-sensitive exact front+back duplicate matching. remainingCapacity nil means uncapped (Plus). Round-trips losslessly with export.

interfaces.name: CardRepository
interfaces.signature: public protocol CardRepository { func create(deckID: UUID, front: String, back: String, note: String?) async throws -> Card; func cardsDue(at instant: Date, calendar: Calendar, forDeck: UUID?, includeArchived: Bool) async throws -> [Card]; func card(forID id: UUID) async throws -> Card? }
interfaces.notes: Single source of due-card queries; never return mutable due booleans.

interfaces.name: DeckRepository
interfaces.signature: public protocol DeckRepository { func fetchAllDecks(includeArchived: Bool) throws -> [Deck]; func createDeck(name: String) throws -> Deck; func archiveDeck(id: UUID) throws; func deleteDeck(id: UUID) throws }
interfaces.notes: Backed by the single app-wide ModelContext; runs on the main actor.

interfaces.name: ReviewLogRepository
interfaces.signature: public protocol ReviewLogRepository { func append(_ entry: ReviewLogEntry) async throws; func history(for cardID: UUID) async throws -> [ReviewLogEntry]; func deleteByCardID(_ cardID: UUID) async throws }
interfaces.notes: Append-only writes only; no update API exposed to enforce immutability.

interfaces.name: ModelContainerManager
interfaces.signature: public protocol ModelContainerManager { func start() throws -> ModelContainer; var container: ModelContainer? { get } var isRecoveredState: Bool { get } }
interfaces.notes: Single container owner for app lifetime, with explicit open-failure recovery path.

interfaces.name: ReviewSessionPlan
interfaces.signature: public struct ReviewSessionPlan { public let sessionID: UUID; public let scope: SessionScope; public let dueCardIDs: [UUID]; public let startedAt: Date }
interfaces.notes: Snapshotted once at session start via ReviewRepository.fetchDueCards; never re-fetched mid-session (DEC-design_handoff-004).

interfaces.name: ReviewSessionService
interfaces.signature: public protocol ReviewSessionService { func start(scope: SessionScope, now: Date) throws -> ReviewSessionPlan; func gradeCard(sessionID: UUID, cardID: UUID, grade: Grade, now: Date) throws -> GradeOutcome }
interfaces.notes: If cardID in the plan no longer resolves to a live Card (deleted/cascaded between snapshot and grading), the caller must skip it and increment a stale-skip counter — never crash, never fabricate a grade or silently shrink the visible summary without recording the skip.

interfaces.name: SessionScope
interfaces.signature: public enum SessionScope: Sendable { case singleDeck(UUID); case allDecks }
interfaces.notes: Matches Study-deck-specific and Study-All entry points.

interfaces.name: StatsService
interfaces.signature: public protocol StatsService { func forecastNext30Days(deckID: UUID?) async throws -> [DailyForecastPoint]; func dailyHistory(deckID: UUID?, days: Int) async throws -> [ReviewCountPoint]; func retentionRate(deckID: UUID?, from: Date, to: Date) async throws -> Double }
interfaces.notes: Computed against persistent logs with demo-data exclusion filter applied in one central place.

interfaces.name: ReminderService
interfaces.signature: public protocol ReminderService { func refreshNotifications(now: Date) async throws; func requestPermissionIfNeeded() async throws -> Bool; func setReminder(enabled: Bool, atComponents: DateComponents?, deckID: UUID?) async throws }
interfaces.notes: Use non-repeating schedule semantics and avoid notifications with stale due-count text.

interfaces.name: SubscriptionService
interfaces.signature: public protocol SubscriptionService { func currentPlan() async throws -> PlanStatus; func purchasePlus() async throws; func restorePurchases() async throws -> PlanStatus }
interfaces.notes: StoreKit 2 backed; purchase/restore is the one sanctioned network touch. Offline purchase attempt must return a bounded error, not hang.

interfaces.name: RecallPersistenceError
interfaces.signature: public enum RecallPersistenceError: Error { case containerOpenFailed; case saveFailed; case deleteFailed; case migrationNeeded }
interfaces.notes: Errors must surface in UI as honest states; never hidden in background.

interfaces.name: DeckListViewState
interfaces.signature: public struct DeckListViewState { public let isLoading: Bool; public let isEmpty: Bool; public let allCaughtUp: Bool; public let decks: [DeckCellVM]; public let hasError: Bool; public let errorMessage: String? }
interfaces.notes: Explicit distinct all-caught-up vs true-empty semantics per DEC-design_discussion-005.

interfaces.name: ReviewSessionViewModel
interfaces.signature: @Observable @MainActor public final class ReviewSessionViewModel { public private(set) var queue: [UUID]; public private(set) var currentIndex: Int; public private(set) var isRevealed: Bool; public private(set) var capHit: Bool; public private(set) var gradedCount: Int; public private(set) var againCount: Int; public private(set) var staleSkippedCount: Int; func reveal(); func grade(_ grade: Grade) async; func endSessionEarly() }
interfaces.notes: queue is the ReviewSessionPlan.dueCardIDs snapshot, stepped by index only. staleSkippedCount surfaces the stale-ID-skip edge case in the session summary rather than hiding it. Supports both GradeStaircase taps and optional keyboard shortcuts (space/return=reveal, 1-4/arrows=grade) as two input paths to the same grade(_:) call — keyboard is additive, VoiceOver/staircase labels remain the accessibility path of record.

interfaces.name: Clock
interfaces.signature: public protocol Clock: Sendable { func now() -> Date }
interfaces.notes: Injected everywhere in RecallScheduling/RecallCSV; SystemClock is the only production conformer. No domain code calls Date()/Calendar.current directly.

interfaces.name: Grade
interfaces.signature: public enum Grade: Int, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable { case again = 2, hard = 3, good = 4, easy = 5 }
interfaces.notes: Raw value is the SM-2 quality score q, per DEC-detailed_discussion-001.

interfaces.name: SchedulingState
interfaces.signature: public struct SchedulingState: Equatable, Sendable { public var easeFactor: Double; public var intervalDays: Int; public var repetitionCount: Int }
interfaces.notes: Pure value type; no cardID/dueDate — those live in GradeOutcome so this stays a minimal SM2Engine input/output.

interfaces.name: SM2Engine.schedule
interfaces.signature: public static func schedule(current: SchedulingState, grade: Grade) -> SchedulingState
interfaces.notes: Literal SuperMemo-2 arithmetic per DEC-detailed_discussion-001; EF floor 1.3; lapse (q<3) resets repetitionCount to 0 and intervalDays to 1.

interfaces.name: SM2Engine.isDue
interfaces.signature: public static func isDue(dueDate: Date, now: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> Bool
interfaces.notes: due iff dueDate < startOfTomorrow(now, calendar); recomputed at query time, never stored as a boolean.

interfaces.name: SM2Engine.startOfTomorrow
interfaces.signature: public static func startOfTomorrow(now: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> Date
interfaces.notes: Single shared definition of calendar-day boundary used by isDue, forecast bucketing, and history bucketing.

interfaces.name: CSVParser.parseImportPreview
interfaces.signature: public static func parseImportPreview(data: Data, existingCards: [(front: String, back: String)], remainingCapacity: Int?) -> [CSVRowStatus]
interfaces.notes: Pure, no I/O. Case-sensitive exact front+back duplicate matching per DEC-detailed_discussion-006. remainingCapacity nil means uncapped (Plus).

interfaces.name: CSVParser.exportCSV
interfaces.signature: public static func exportCSV(cards: [(front: String, back: String, note: String?)]) -> Data
interfaces.notes: Three-column front/back/note export; round-trips losslessly with parseImportPreview.

interfaces.name: Deck
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Deck { var id: UUID; var name: String; var createdAt: Date; var archivedAt: Date?; var isDemo: Bool; var reminderHour: Int?; var reminderMinute: Int?; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Card.deck) var cards: [Card] }
interfaces.notes: archivedAt != nil means archived, not deleted; archived decks still count toward Free caps. reminderHour/Minute implement per-deck Plus reminder override.

interfaces.name: Card
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Card { var id: UUID; var front: String; var back: String; var note: String?; var easeFactor: Double; var intervalDays: Int; var repetitionCount: Int; var dueDate: Date; var lastReviewedAt: Date?; var isDemo: Bool; var createdAt: Date; var deck: Deck?; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \ReviewLog.card) var logs: [ReviewLog] }
interfaces.notes: isDemo denormalized from parent Deck at creation, never derived via join. dueDate is authoritative storage but due-ness is always computed via SM2Engine.isDue at query time.

interfaces.name: ReviewLog
interfaces.signature: @Model final class ReviewLog { var id: UUID; var timestamp: Date; var grade: Int; var easeFactorBefore: Double; var easeFactorAfter: Double; var intervalBefore: Int; var intervalAfter: Int; var repetitionBefore: Int; var repetitionAfter: Int; var card: Card? }
interfaces.notes: Append-only: repository exposes insert only, no update method exists anywhere. Cascade-deleted when its Card is deleted.

interfaces.name: RecallDataError
interfaces.signature: public enum RecallDataError: Error, Sendable { case containerUnavailable(underlying: String); case saveFailed(underlying: String); case notFound }
interfaces.notes: Thrown by repositories; view models map these to ErrorBlock states, never force-try. containerUnavailable drives the app-root recovery screen.

interfaces.name: ModelContainerFactory
interfaces.signature: public enum ModelContainerFactory { public static func makeContainer() -> Result<ModelContainer, RecallDataError> }
interfaces.notes: No try!. Includes VersionedSchema/SchemaMigrationPlan scaffolding from v1. Failure result drives AppRootState.recoveryNeeded, offering retry or explicit start-fresh.

interfaces.name: ReviewRepository
interfaces.signature: public protocol ReviewRepository { func fetchDueCards(deckIDs: [UUID]?, now: Date) throws -> [Card]; func recordGrade(cardID: UUID, grade: Grade, now: Date) throws -> GradeOutcome; func createCard(front: String, back: String, note: String?, deckID: UUID) throws -> Card; func deleteCard(id: UUID) throws }
interfaces.notes: recordGrade performs a synchronous context.save() before returning, per DEC-detailed_discussion-004. deckIDs nil means Study All. Uses UUID (not PersistentIdentifier) so this contract stays usable from primary_ui without importing SwiftData.

interfaces.name: StatsSnapshot
interfaces.signature: public struct StatsSnapshot: Equatable, Sendable { public var forecast: [ForecastBucket]; public var history: [HistoryPoint]; public var retentionRate: Double?; public var sampleSize: Int }
interfaces.notes: retentionRate is nil (not 0) when sampleSize == 0, to distinguish empty from 0% retention.

interfaces.name: ForecastBucket
interfaces.signature: public struct ForecastBucket: Equatable, Sendable, Identifiable { public var id: Date; public var dayOffset: Int; public var dueCount: Int }
interfaces.notes: 30 entries, dayOffset 0...29; day 0 is 'today', rendered in accentAmber per design_handoff.

interfaces.name: HistoryPoint
interfaces.signature: public struct HistoryPoint: Equatable, Sendable, Identifiable { public var id: Date; public var reviewCount: Int; public var againCount: Int }
interfaces.notes: Daily review history; demo data excluded by default.

interfaces.name: StatsComputationActor
interfaces.signature: @ModelActor public actor StatsComputationActor { func computeOverview(excludeDemo: Bool, now: Date) -> StatsSnapshot; func computeDeckStats(deckID: UUID, now: Date) -> StatsSnapshot }
interfaces.notes: Owns its own read-only ModelContext against the same single container; triggered by ModelContext.didSave notifications and post-session completion — a concurrency domain fully separate from the main-actor write path. Must never be inlined into a SwiftUI view body.

interfaces.name: StatsCache
interfaces.signature: @Observable @MainActor public final class StatsCache { public private(set) var overview: StatsSnapshot?; public private(set) var perDeck: [UUID: StatsSnapshot]; func refresh() async }
interfaces.notes: Single source stats views read from; the demo-exclusion filter lives here exactly once, not reimplemented per chart.

interfaces.name: PlanGate
interfaces.signature: @Observable @MainActor public final class PlanGate { public private(set) var isPlus: Bool; public private(set) var deckCount: Int; public private(set) var nonDemoCardCount: Int; func canCreateDeck() -> Bool; func canCreateCard(in deckID: UUID) -> Bool; func refreshEntitlement() async }
interfaces.notes: Single injected instance; card editor, CSV import preview, and deck creation all read this rather than three independently-maintained cap counters.

interfaces.name: ReminderScheduler
interfaces.signature: public struct ReminderScheduler { func requestAuthorizationIfNeeded() async -> Bool; func rescheduleForTomorrow(dueCount: Int, at time: DateComponents) async; func cancelPending() async }
interfaces.notes: repeats:false, remove-then-readd at the four refresh points (foreground/background/post-session/day-rollover); never schedules when dueCount == 0.

interfaces.name: GapRegisterEntry
interfaces.signature: public struct GapRegisterEntry: Identifiable, Sendable { public var id: String; public var title: String; public var body: String }
interfaces.notes: Static content array; asserted by an automated test to contain each required disclosure string (StoreKit exception, notification never-created framing, timezone-crossing due flips, iCloud backup divergence, full non-goals list).

interfaces.name: StudyRoute
interfaces.signature: public enum StudyRoute: Hashable { case deckDetail(UUID); case reviewSession(scope: SessionScope) }
interfaces.notes: Typed route array per tab (StudyRoute/StatsRoute/SettingsRoute) instead of a type-erased NavigationPath, for compile-time-checked navigation across parallel build lanes.

interfaces.name: DemoDataSeeder
interfaces.signature: public struct DemoDataSeeder { func seed() throws; func removeAll() throws }
interfaces.notes: removeAll leaves zero residue in StatsCache/PlanGate counts, per DEC-initial_discussion-005.

interfaces.name: ReviewLogEntry
interfaces.notes: Records each user interaction during a review session.

interfaces.name: saveDeck
interfaces.signature: func saveDeck(_ deck: Deck) async throws -> UUID
interfaces.notes: Saves a new or updated deck to the database.

interfaces.name: deleteDeck
interfaces.signature: func deleteDeck(withId deckId: UUID) async throws -> Void
interfaces.notes: Deletes a deck and all associated cards from the database.

interfaces.name: fetchCardsForDeck
interfaces.signature: func fetchCardsForDeck(withId deckId: UUID) async throws -> [Card]
interfaces.notes: Retrieves all cards associated with a given deck.

interfaces.name: recordReviewGrade
interfaces.signature: func recordReviewGrade(cardId: UUID, grade: Int) async throws -> Void
interfaces.notes: Records a user's review grade for a specific card.

interfaces.name: GradeOutcome
interfaces.signature: public struct GradeOutcome: Equatable, Sendable { public let state: SchedulingState; public let dueDate: Date; public let wasLapse: Bool }
interfaces.notes: Returned by ReviewRepository.recordGrade; wasLapse true iff grade == .again, for ReviewLog before/after logging and again-rate stats.

interfaces.name: AppRootState
interfaces.signature: public enum AppRootState { case loading; case ready(ModelContainer); case recoveryNeeded(RecallDataError) }
interfaces.notes: Drives the app-launch recovery screen instead of a crash when the store fails to open.
